title: What's new in Expense Agent: Improved Mileage Handling (2026 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Mileage rate setup with dates and vehicles
Vehicle types table and currency options

features.name: Date-range mileage allowances
features.description: Mileage setup now supports configurable start and end dates for mileage allowances, allowing automatic transitions between different rates on period boundaries without manual adjustment.
caveats: Only applies if configured in mileage rate setup; does not override simple standard rate model if set
System automatically uses previous allowance on last day of previous period and new allowance in next period

features.name: Vehicle-type-specific mileage rates
features.description: Users can configure different mileage rates for different vehicle types such as car, truck, SUV, and motorcycle. System automatically applies the correct rate when a vehicle type is selected during expense entry.
caveats: If vehicle types are not configured, they are not offered during expense entry
User must explicitly select the vehicle type; system does not auto-detect

features.name: Mileage rate setup table
features.description: New table for configuring mileage rates by date range and vehicle type. Supports currency code configuration, though local currency is typical for mileage allowances.
caveats: Currency code is optional; most companies use local currency for mileage
